title: Book Three · Chapter 8: The Warm Bread
story:
On Saturday morning, Ronan takes the blue bike into the lane.

Mum gives him money for bread. She has a customer at ten. Dad is at Mr Sun's place until the afternoon.

“Four pieces?” Ronan asks.

“Yes. And keep them flat.”

He looks at the bag in her hand.

“Is the bread very weak?”

“No. But your father does not want it under the bicycle.”

Ronan puts the clean bag in his basket. He rides along the quiet part of the lane. Near the busy corner, he gets off and pushes.

Two carts stand outside the vegetable shop. He waits behind them. The old bell shines in the morning light, but he keeps his hand on the handlebar.

At the bread shop, a new tray comes out. Warm air reaches his face.

“Four, please,” he says.

The woman puts four pieces in a paper bag. Ronan pays and places them inside Mum's bag.

He starts to leave. Then he sees a small round bun on another tray.

He checks his own pocket. He has a little money there.

“And one of those.”

Outside, he takes a bite. The middle is still very hot.

He opens his mouth and breathes out.

An old man near the door looks at him.

“Too hot?”

Ronan nods.

“The first bite always wants to leave.”

Ronan laughs carefully. He waits before the next bite.

At home, Mum is measuring a sleeve. Her customer stands near the window with one arm out.

Ronan carries the bread to the kitchen. Then he takes his school books into the yard. He can hear Mum and the woman discuss the sleeve through the open window.

After the customer leaves, Mum comes out.

“Did you get four?”

“Four pieces of bread. And one bun for me.”

“Is there any bun left?”

He shows her the empty paper.

“A very small bag,” she says.

That afternoon, Dad comes home with dust on his trousers. He washes and sits down. Mum brings out the bread and a small dish of vegetables.

Ronan puts three cups on the table.

Dad picks up a piece of bread.

“It kept its shape.”

“I pushed the bike at the busy corner.”

“Good. Was the shop busy?”

“Only the bread. It tried to burn my mouth.”

He tells them about the bun and the old man.

Mum laughs. Dad breaks his bread in two and dips one end into the dish.

After the meal, Mum goes out to meet a friend. Dad wants to rest for a while. Ronan takes his book to the window.

The blue bike stands in the yard. The bread bag hangs beside the kitchen door, ready for another morning.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

basket＝车篮；handlebar＝自行车车把；tray＝托盘；take a bite＝咬一口。

## 理解问题

1. Ronan在繁忙路口怎样带着自行车前进？
2. 买面包时，他另外用自己的钱买了什么？回家后父母各有什么安排？

## 读句子

**He waits behind them.**

拆开看：He / waits / behind them.

他／等着／在它们后面（them指前面的两辆手推车）。
